provenance.provenance_class: Known method implemented for this challenge

provenance.local_change: Haar-Stiefel/QR frames, antipodal pairing, mean-chi radius, exact first layer and budget-sized frame schedule. Established tools combined and implemented here; not an unchanged public challenge submission.

provenance.local_change: One Haar frame blended 0.25/0.75 with the bundled full-covariance closure. The project contribution is the concrete cost-aware composition; shrinkage and Gaussian closure are known.

provenance.local_change: Order-12 Price/Hermite closure plus an independent partial-Haar arm and fixed fusion weights. A locally developed allocation and combination of known tools.

provenance.local_change: Harmonic-shrunk terminal skew/Edgeworth correction, alpha-stratified fusion and nested partial extension. The source registry calls this OURS, while its sampling and closure lineage uses established ingredients.

provenance.provenance_class: Local features and calibration on inherited machinery
provenance.local_change: A 12-feature analytic-synthesis observer, locally fitted coefficients, correction cap and output projection over ALG019. Public/known numerical ingredients remain inherited.

provenance.local_change: Combines a public MIT fast multiplication kernel with an independent child frame, cross-frame harmonic reliability and the fitted analytic observer. Substantive local composition; multiplication algorithm is public.

provenance.local_change: Replaces the terminal harmonic-skew correction with a radial-law-corrected physical third-cumulant trace projection; retains the existing observer coefficients. A local mathematical adaptation, not a new fit.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established by this audit; labels describe recorded implementation/method provenance, not a priority claim.

provenance.local_change: Cap-aware anchored physical-response recalibration with a fixed Hermite remainder, followed by a local coefficient fit. Incremental response/calibration work on ALG028.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established by this audit; labels describe recorded implementation/method provenance, not a priority claim.

provenance.local_change: Parity-split physical response features and a fitted correction on ALG029. A local extension and recalibration of the inherited estimator.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established by this audit; labels describe recorded implementation/method provenance, not a priority claim.

provenance.local_change: Transfers the five absolute-state calibration features from venture_agent_ai public work into our own ALG031 state, with our coefficients fitted locally. Neither a wholly local feature invention nor a copied complete estimator.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established by this audit; labels describe recorded implementation/method provenance, not a priority claim.

provenance.local_change: One joint regularized refit of the existing 27 correction columns. No new feature vocabulary, sampling rule or recurrence; inherits the local/public mixture of ALG036.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established by this audit; labels describe recorded implementation/method provenance, not a priority claim.

provenance.provenance_class: Substantial mathematical adaptation of published method
provenance.local_change: Public joint-cumulant framework rebuilt as our paired compressed full-history recurrence, with repeated-index completion, radial fourth scalar and signed mean/covariance response. Reuses public fast multiplication. No local fit; not an exact implementation of the full published method.

provenance.provenance_class: Compute-only change from adapted public-method parent
provenance.local_change: Retains ALG038-V000 state and recurrence; uses final marginal contractions and a four-level multiplication schedule. The fresh contribution is lower cost, not a new statistical mechanism.

provenance.provenance_class: Local mathematical derivative of adapted public framework
provenance.local_change: Adds the locally derived/implemented JSP fresh-source joint response to ALG038-V001 and recomputes repeated-entry completion. No local fit. Related cumulant-response ideas are published; this record does not establish academic priority.

provenance.local_change: 504aldo public V29 at commit18c17e2d7a9aeacd399cfc2c6b571e4e16dbfb45, numerical source byte-identical. Published terms, fitted tables, defaults and schedules unchanged. Only packaging, qualification and harness work were ours.

provenance.provenance_class: Local mathematical and compute adaptations of public code
provenance.local_change: Starts from public V29 and adds the coupled native history basis, covariance-cup compensation for lost third-tensor trace, ranks320/192 and Winograd/shared-arena arithmetic. Inherits V29 calibration and core machinery; no new fit. The Winograd algorithm itself is established.

provenance.local_change: Prune the nonlinear interface using |alpha| <= 2.5, repair omitted-row trace, and gate young sources from layer 5. Keeps inherited fitted tables; no new target-coefficient fit.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established; this is an implementation/provenance assessment, not a priority claim.

provenance.short_label: Modified public V29; supervised response fit
provenance.local_change: Add 124 fitted coefficients predicting propagated mean residuals from marginal and pair fields. The physical recurrence is inherited from ALG050; public-training supervision is explicit.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established; this is an implementation/provenance assessment, not a priority claim.

provenance.short_label: Modified public V29; learned local source
provenance.local_change: Learn local mean innovations from intermediate-layer supervision and propagate a separate response vector. Small neural source and combined objective are project additions; learned closure is an established idea.

provenance.short_label: Modified public V29; fitted physical covariance recurrence
provenance.local_change: Add a 32-field covariance-defect dictionary with 96 fitted coefficients in three depth bins. Unlike a terminal calibration, this changes the physical covariance trajectory and later means.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established; this is an implementation/provenance assessment, not a priority claim.

provenance.short_label: Modified public e30_a; covariance correction and fused arithmetic
provenance.local_change: Port the T170 covariance dictionary to LordProcciuto’s lower-cost e30_a engine and fuse low-rank contractions. The public engine supplied most of the historical improvement. Its existing fitted mean table remains.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established; this is an implementation/provenance assessment, not a priority claim.

provenance.short_label: Modified public e30_a; learned trace-informed source
provenance.local_change: Add a 24-input, 32-hidden-unit, four-head tanh source trained on 32 public networks. Transport its innovations through a separate Gaussian mean-response recurrence and add the response to the final prediction.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established; this is an implementation/provenance assessment, not a priority claim.

provenance.short_label: Modified public e30_a; fixed average of learned sources
provenance.local_change: Average ALG055’s trace source with a 48-input context source trained on 64 public networks. A 72-coordinate/64-hidden-unit batch preserves both normalizers and clipping rules; the mixture weight is fixed at one half.
provenance.academic_novelty: Not established; this is an implementation/provenance assessment, not a priority claim.
